claims.text: Grand Hyatt Berlin stands at Potsdamer Platz.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Berlin stands at Potsdamer Platz, the square at the heart of Berlin's transformation.

claims.text: Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag Building and the Tiergarten are all within walking distance of the hotel.

findings.quote: with Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag Building and the Tiergarten all within walking distance
findings.note: All three landmarks are listed as within walking distance.

claims.text: The hotel is steps from the Potsdamer Platz U-Bahn station and a short walk to the site of the Berlin Wall.

findings.quote: just steps away from the Potsdamer Platz U-Bahn station and a short walk to the site of the Berlin Wall

claims.text: Artists in the hotel's collection include Sylvie Fleury, John Armleder, Günther Förg, Dieter Roth and Jaehyo Lee.

findings.quote: Sylvie Fleury, John Armleder, Günther Förg, Dieter Roth and Jaehyo Lee are only a few of the names that have created the art you can explore throughout the hotel.

claims.text: Design elements include a crystal-shaped roof light, Lebanese cedarwood, black granite and backlit alabaster walls.

findings.quote: Design elements include a crystal-shaped roof light, Lebanese cedarwood, black granite, stucco posts, backlit alabaster walls, and a large atrium lobby.
findings.note: All four listed elements are covered.

claims.text: The spa has an indoor pool, whirlpool, outdoor terrace, sauna, steam bath, solarium and fitness area.

findings.quote: An indoor pool, whirlpool, outdoor terrace, sauna, steam bath, solarium and fitness area are all available
findings.note: Every facility in the claim is listed.

claims.text: Access to Club Olympus Spa & Fitness is complimentary for hotel guests.

findings.quote: Club Olympus Spa & Fitness is complimentary for hotel guests
findings.note: States complimentary access for hotel guests.

claims.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with a deep soaking tub and walk-in shower, appointed with Balmain amenities.

findings.quote: the marble bathroom features a deep soaking tub and walk-in shower, appointed with Balmain amenities.

claims.text: The Junior Suite overlooks the greenery of the Tiergarten, with cherrywood and marble finishes.

findings.quote: all overlooking the peaceful greenery of the Tiergarten. Rich cherrywood and marble finishes add warmth and refinement throughout
findings.note: Junior Suite description covers both the view and the finishes.

claims.text: VOX Restaurant & Terrace is named after the historic Vox-Haus that once stood on the site.

findings.quote: Named after the historic Vox-Haus that once stood on this site, VOX Restaurant & Terrace has been a Berlin dining institution since 1998.
findings.note: Confirms the origin of the name.

claims.text: VOX Bar has a collection of more than 300 spirits and whiskies.

findings.quote: VOX Bar is one of Berlin's most celebrated bars, home to a collection of more than 300 spirits and whiskies.

claims.text: The Very Important Baby program provides cribs, nightlights, diapers, baby-changing facilities and children's bathrobes.

findings.quote: The Very Important Baby program provides cribs, nightlights, diapers, baby-changing facilities and children's bathrobes

claims.text: The hotel houses a curated collection of over 120 pieces of art, displayed from the lobby to the restaurants and rooms.

findings.quote: Our curated collection of over 120 pieces of art was carefully selected to intrigue, surprise and create a vibrant and interesting atmosphere throughout the Hotel.
From our lobby over our restaurants to our rooms, the Grand Hyatt Berlin houses art pieces from artists from the world over.

claims.text: The modern sandstone hotel was designed by Jose Rafael Moneo.

findings.quote: This modern sandstone hotel in a mixed-use development, designed by José Rafael Moneo
findings.note: Confirms the architect and the sandstone construction.

claims.text: Club Olympus Spa & Fitness occupies the 8th floor, with panoramic views across the Berlin skyline.

findings.quote: Club Olympus Spa & Fitness occupies the 8th floor of Grand Hyatt Berlin, offering spectacular panoramic views across the Berlin skyline

claims.text: The Maybach Suite has a grand piano and a private conference room.

findings.quote: elegant living and working spaces with a grand piano and a private conference room

claims.text: The Grand Club on the 7th floor offers a complimentary continental breakfast buffet, all-day refreshments and an evening cocktail hour with canapes.

findings.quote: Located on the 7th floor, it offers a level of personal, individualized service rarely found elsewhere
Each day begins with a complimentary continental breakfast buffet, followed by all-day refreshments in a lounge designed equally for relaxation, work or informal meetings.
As evening approaches, the Grand Club hosts a cocktail hour with a creative selection of canapés.

claims.text: Self-parking is in a public Q-Park garage at Potsdamer Platz, with direct access to the hotel lobby.

findings.quote: The driveway to the Q-Park parking garage at Potsdamer Platz is located in the Ludwig-Beck-Straße, 10785 and offers direct access to the hotel lobby. Please note that this is a public parking facility
findings.note: Covers Q-Park, public facility, and direct lobby access.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes Potsdamer Platz is a lively commercial hub, which may feel less quiet than a residential neighborhood.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the hotel's top-tier market position.
